note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 15 November 2026, RealHunt lists 14 homes for sale in Greece, each one checked by a person.
In Greece, the median asking price of those 14 homes is €115,000 (€1,397 per m², from the 13 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €68,000 and the most expensive €159,990.
Taxes and fees add about 5.5–7% to the price of a home in Greece (figures as of 2026).

buying.costs_breakdown: Transfer tax 3.09% of the price or the taxable value, whichever is higher; notary about 0.8-1% plus VAT; land registry fees about 0.5-0.7%; lawyer 1-2% plus VAT; if an agent is used, the buyer usually pays a commission of 1-3% plus VAT on top.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes. Buyers from outside the EU and EFTA need a permit to buy in designated border areas (parts of northern Greece and eastern Aegean islands such as the Dodecanese and Rhodes). The government has announced a 15% transfer tax for non-EU buyers of homes from 1 January 2027, not yet final in September 2026.
buying.annual_property_tax: Owners on 1 January pay the unified property tax (ENFIA), calculated per property from its location, size, age and official zone value, with an extra charge if total Greek property exceeds €500,000.
buying.rental_income_tax: Non-residents pay Greek tax on Greek rental income at 15% up to €12,000, 25% to €24,000, 35% to €36,000 and 45% above, after a flat 5% deduction for expenses.

homes.title: Three-bedroom village house with a vine-covered terrace and sea views in Messinia
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de tres dormitorios con terraza de parra y vistas al mar en Mesenia
homes.summary: A 116 m² two-storey house in Vasilitsi, at the southern tip of the Messinian peninsula, with views over the sea and the hills: three bedrooms, two kitchens, two living rooms and two bathrooms, a covered veranda and a vine-shaded terrace with blue railings, plus a roof terrace with views of the sea and mountains. Air conditioning, double glazing and wooden floors. Memi and Ammoudi beaches are about 3 km away. Asking €109,000, about €940/m².

homes.title: Whitewashed Cretan village house with a roof terrace and spiral stairs
homes.title_es: Casa encalada en un pueblo de Creta con azotea y escalera de caracol
homes.summary: A renovated 93 m² detached house in the traditional village of Choumeriako, 3 km from Neapoli and 13 km from the beaches of Agios Nikolaos. Downstairs, a modern kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom with a corner bath; a spiral staircase leads up to a lovely sitting room with a wood stove that opens onto a big terrace with umbrellas and views over the village. Stone arches, wooden beams and whitewashed walls keep its old character. Asking €115,000, about €1,237/m².

homes.title: Two-level stone house with a sea view in Marathokampos, Samos
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de dos plantas con vistas al mar en Marathokampos, Samos
homes.summary: A well-kept 80 m² stone house in the upper part of Marathokampos, in the Agia Triada area, with a wonderful view of the sea. On the ground floor a kitchen, a dining room and a bathroom; upstairs two bedrooms, a living room, a hall and a WC. Wooden window frames, parquet and tiled floors and a wood boiler for heating. A traditional house in a picturesque spot, ready to live in. Asking €68,000, about €850/m².

homes.title: Stone island house with blue doors and a sea view over to Skiathos
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra en la isla con puertas azules y vistas al mar hacia Skiathos
homes.summary: A 110 m² stone maisonette in Paleo Klima, Glossa, on the Mamma Mia island of Skopelos, with an open, unobstructed view of the Aegean and Skiathos. Bright blue shutters and doors, wooden beamed ceilings, a traditional fireplace corner, a sunny kitchen-living room and two bedrooms over two levels. Close to the main road with easy access, and sold ready to move into. Asking €150,000, about €1,364/m².

homes.title: Traditional corner house in Agiasos, Lesbos' mountain village
homes.title_es: Casa tradicional de esquina en Agiasos, el pueblo de montaña de Lesbos
homes.summary: A traditional corner residence with two bedrooms in Agiasos, at about 460 m on the green slopes of Mount Olympus on Lesbos, a village known for pottery and woodcarving. Freshly painted facade with balcony, stone and wood details inside, and the island's beaches and olive groves around it.

homes.title: Renovated stone house with a Libyan Sea view in Agios Vasileios, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra reformada con vistas al mar de Libia en Agios Vasileios, Creta
homes.summary: A 61 m² stone house in the village of Agios Vasileios (Viannos), renovated in 2010, with a sweeping view over olive groves to the Libyan Sea from its terraces. An open living room and kitchen under wooden beams, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a small storeroom in the yard, on a 148 m² plot with parking outside. Sold furnished. Energy rating D. Asking €76,000, about €1,246/m².

homes.title: Renovated stone house with a sea view in Marathokampos, Samos
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra reformada con vistas al mar en Marathokampos, Samos
homes.summary: A renovated two-storey stone house in the Profitis Ilias quarter of Marathokampos, high above the bay, with a wide sea view from the balcony and windows. Downstairs a living room, a kitchen and a bathroom open onto a small courtyard; upstairs two bright bedrooms. Double glazing and air conditioning; sold furnished and with appliances, ready to move into. Energy rating F. Asking €80,000, about €1,250/m².

homes.title: Fairy-tale house with a gazebo and stone BBQ in the Pelion forest
homes.title_es: Casa de cuento con cenador y barbacoa de piedra en el bosque de Pelion
homes.summary: Surrounded by towering trees in the mountain village of Chania in Pelion, a 68 m² single-family house renovated in 2021 on a 213 m² corner plot: a wood-lined living room with a fireplace, a bedroom with its own fireplace, a modern kitchen, a bathroom and a small veranda, plus a 29 m² basement, two storerooms, a built-in stone BBQ and a large covered gazebo in a green garden. Sold with furniture and three inverter air conditioners. Asking €95,000, about €1,397/m².

homes.title: Furnished Cretan house with a shared pool for just four homes
homes.title_es: Casa amueblada en Creta con piscina compartida entre solo cuatro casas
homes.summary: Villa Dionysos: a fully furnished 76 m² two-bedroom house over two floors in a small, quiet complex in Drapanos, near Chania. A bright open-plan living room with a corner sofa and fireplace opens onto a covered private terrace; the kitchen and dining area look out over the pool, shared by only four houses and backed by open countryside. Upstairs, two double bedrooms, each with its own terrace, the master with sea views. Asking €158,000, about €2,079/m².

homes.title: Furnished two-bedroom flat with a sea view in Pefki, North Evia
homes.title_es: Piso amueblado de dos dormitorios con vistas al mar en Pefki, norte de Eubea
homes.summary: A 50 m² first-floor flat a few hundred metres from the beach in Pefki, on the island of Evia, with a sea view from the balcony. Two bedrooms, a fitted kitchen, a modern shower room and a dining corner, all freshly finished with light floors. Electric heating, air conditioning, a security door and parking. Sold fully furnished and equipped, ready to use or rent out. Energy rating E. Asking €80,000, about €1,600/m².

homes.title: Modern, furnished two-bedroom house near the sea on Rhodes
homes.title_es: Casa moderna y amueblada de dos dormitorios cerca del mar en Rodas
homes.summary: An 84 m² detached house in Paradeisi on Rhodes, in very good condition, modern, bright and sold furnished: a stylish kitchen with a breakfast bar and pendant lights, a living room, two bedrooms and a bathroom. Air conditioning, a solar water heater, aluminium frames and tiled floors, with no shared expenses. Close to the sea, shops, cafés and the island's airport. Asking €155,000, about €1,845/m².

homes.title: Brand-new 2025 cottage with a pergola deck 400 m from the sea in Halkidiki
homes.title_es: Casita nueva de 2025 con porche de pérgola a 400 m del mar en Calcídica
homes.summary: A new-build 72 m² house from 2025 in Kallikrateia, Halkidiki, energy class A and sold furnished: three bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and three bathrooms, with a big wooden pergola deck, string lights for summer evenings, a garden with banana plants, parking, A/C, double glazing and a BBQ. The sea is 400 m away and Thessaloniki airport about 45 km. Asking €159,990, about €2,222/m².

homes.title: Wooden island-style house with a BBQ terrace hanging over the Pagasetic Gulf
homes.title_es: Casa de madera estilo isla con terraza y barbacoa sobre el golfo Pagasético
homes.summary: In the cobbled, island-like village of Trikeri at the tip of Pelion, a 54 m² house on two levels: a carefully renovated wooden studio with a high ceiling, a loft with a double bed, kitchen, dining area and bathroom, opening onto a big covered terrace with a wood oven, a BBQ and a fantastic view of the sea. Below, a separate 15 m² studio with its own kitchen and shower. Sleeps six; use it as one house or two holiday flats. Asking €120,000, about €2,222/m².

homes.title: Summer cottage on a 980 m² garden plot 2 km from the beach
homes.title_es: Casita de verano en una parcela de 980 m² a 2 km de la playa
homes.summary: A 62 m² house on a flat plot of 980 m² among olive trees and just a few neighbours, near Marathopolis: a sitting area with a wood stove, an open kitchen, a bedroom and a shower room downstairs, and a wooden staircase up to an attic with a balcony and extra beds. A garden with paths, a storeroom and a built-in BBQ. 2 km to Lagouvardos beach, 15 minutes to Gialova and its golf courses, 25 to Pylos. Asking €158,000, about €2,548/m².
